## TeslaMate

Teslatlas reads from a TeslaMate or MyTeslaMate source that you configure. For TeslaMate installation and operation, use the official channels:

- [TeslaMate documentation](https://docs.teslamate.org/)
- [TeslaMate project](https://github.com/teslamate-org/teslamate)
